_readme: Domain-knowledge lookup tables for build_care_template.py's CARE-SM row emission. Edit THIS FILE, not the Python code, to add a CURIE prefix, a sex/status value synonym, or an affirmative/negative token. Does NOT include TOOLKIT_COLUMNS/MODEL_COLUMNS -- those are the v2 Toolkit's own enforced column contract, copied from its source/example CSVs, not a curation decision, and stay in build_care_template.py.

curie_expand._readme: diagnosis-code prefix -> IRI template ({} is replaced with the local part)

sex_map._readme: lowercased cell value -> NCIT IRI, emitted on Sex.attribute_type
